verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://loops.so/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured product summary, and its content links into guides such as the Content API and migration docs. Loops also runs a dedicated agent-oriented docs hub at /agents covering the API, CLI, MCP, LMX and workflows, plus installable agent skills and an OpenAPI spec that also probes live. Missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the /docs.md probe returned 404) and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or independent user reports of agents consuming these docs.
